lines.en: Shuffling forward in the dark
Feeling a target nearby
Rattling my throat with a hiss
Trying to get closer to the victim

lines.zh: 伸出舌头感受周围环境
lines.en: Extending my tongue to feel the surroundings
Smelling the scent of a human
Ears twitching beside my head

lines.zh: 盯着前方，眼睛闪着绿光
lines.en: Fixing my gaze ahead, green eyes glowing

lines.zh: 泥地上有小脚印，我顺着走。
lines.en: Small tracks in the mud. I follow them.
Muttering ominous words
Both mouths wheeze at once.
My claws rake through the soil.

lines.zh: 头颅间的裂缝中流出黏液
lines.en: Mucus oozes from the cracks between my heads
Both heads gaze into the distance

lines.zh: 呼吸压得很轻，胸口一起一伏。
lines.en: I keep my breath shallow, chest rising and falling.
Licking my own lips
Chewing on the dust in the air
Tilting one head to the side
Swaying my body gently
Observing the changes in my surroundings
Feeling the sounds in the wind
Considering my next move
My two mouths open and close.

lines.zh: 歪着脑袋听远处的动静
lines.en: I tilt my head toward distant sounds.

lines.zh: 用湿冷的舌头舔过牙齿
lines.en: A cold wet tongue slides over my teeth.

lines.zh: 深深吸气，闻着血的味道
lines.en: I breathe deep, tasting blood in the air.

lines.zh: 我注意到了你，你最好不要动。
lines.en: I noticed you, don't move.

lines.zh: 我的兄弟们和我都等待着机会。
lines.en: Our brothers and I wait for our chance.

lines.zh: 你的眼神让我心动，但不要靠近我。
lines.en: Your eyes are tempting, but don't come closer.

lines.zh: 我不会让任何人靠近我的地盘。
lines.en: I won't let anyone near my territory.

lines.zh: 我能看到你身上的恐惧，我喜欢这样。
lines.en: I see the fear in you, and I like it.

lines.zh: 我的兄弟们都在监视你，小心一些。
lines.en: My brothers are watching you, be careful.

lines.zh: 你散发出的气味让我想要接近你。
lines.en: You emit a scent that tempts me to come closer.

lines.zh: 我不能让你这么轻易地逃脱。
lines.en: You can't escape me that easily.

lines.zh: 你看起来很美味，但不要动。
lines.en: You look delicious, but don't move.

lines.zh: 我的兄弟们和我不会放过你的。
lines.en: My brothers and I won't let you go.

lines.zh: 你身上的气味我记住了。
lines.en: I've memorized your scent.
Don't run, I'm not done playing.

lines.zh: 我看见你握紧了手里的东西。
lines.en: I see your grip tighten.
You're trembling, and I can smell it.

lines.zh: 就这么站着，让我看清楚。
lines.en: Just stand there and let me look.
Your shadow has fallen into my mouth.
I've been counting your footsteps.

lines.zh: 你回头的时候，我已经近了。
lines.en: When you look back, I'll be closer.
You're breathing louder than I am.
You can't escape. I know these paths.
Cry out

lines.zh: 我张开两张嘴，只喘不叫。
lines.en: Both my mouths gape, but only breath comes out.
Let out a desperate scream
Pained scream

lines.zh: 野生的幼崽，叫声都一样低。
lines.en: Feral young all call out low like this.
Fiercely scream
Muscles trembling

lines.zh: 我缩起肩膀，牙咬得咯咯响。
lines.en: My shoulders hunch and my teeth grind.
Clutching you tight
Please save me
Hunger Devours
Eternal Gaze
Greedy Stare
Distorted Smile
Devour All Life
Suffering for Survival
Soul's Prisoner
Night's Whisper
Desperate Scream
Death's Embrace

lines.zh: 我感到一股力量在体内涌动，那是...妈妈的呼唤？
lines.en: I feel a force within me, a call... Mom's call?

lines.zh: 我在黑暗中徘徊，寻找...什么？
lines.en: I wander in the darkness, searching for... what?

lines.zh: 我的嘴里有两把锐利的刀，随时准备撕裂一切障碍。
lines.en: I have two sharp teeth ready to tear through any obstacle.

lines.zh: 我必须找到妈妈，她知道一切。
lines.en: I must find Mom, she knows everything.

lines.zh: 我能感觉到它们的存在，它们也在寻找...？
lines.en: I can feel their presence, they're looking for...?

lines.zh: 这里太暗了，但我不会放弃。
lines.en: It's too dark here, but I won't give up.

lines.zh: 我必须保护自己，不能再受伤害。
lines.en: I must protect myself, I can't take any more harm.

lines.zh: 我需要找到一个避难所，等待...什么？
lines.en: I need a safe place, waiting for... what?

lines.zh: 妈妈说过，要勇敢，要找到她。
lines.en: Mom said to be brave, to find her.

lines.zh: 我感觉到一个声音在呼唤我，那声音...熟悉？
lines.en: I feel a voice calling me, that voice... familiar?

lines.zh: 找到你，真是太好了，我的另一半。
lines.en: Finding you, it's great, my other half.

lines.zh: 你就是我一直在寻找的，我的另一半。
lines.en: You're the one I've been searching for, my other half.

lines.zh: 我们是一体的，一起寻找妈妈吧。
lines.en: We're one, let's find Mom together.

lines.zh: 你感受到了吗？我们是同类。
lines.en: Can you feel it? We're the same.

lines.zh: 我们一起成长，一起找到妈妈。
lines.en: We grow together, finding Mom together.

lines.zh: 我们是同类，我们有共同的目标。
lines.en: We're the same, we have a common goal.

lines.zh: 妈妈说过，我们是同类，一起勇敢。
lines.en: Mom said we're the same, together we're brave.

lines.zh: 我们的命运相连，一起面对黑暗。
lines.en: Our fates are linked, facing the darkness together.

lines.zh: 我们一起走过这一切，找到妈妈。
lines.en: We've been through it all together, to find Mom.

lines.zh: 我们是彼此的归宿，一起活下去。
lines.en: We're each other's home, let's live on together.

lines.zh: 苍白的指尖触碰我柔软的身躯，我感受到恐惧。
lines.en: Pale fingertips touch my soft body, I feel fear.

lines.zh: 这世界的光芒刺痛了我的双眼，我几乎要窒息。
lines.en: The light of this world burns my eyes, nearly choking me.

lines.zh: 我必须找到更多养料，才能成长。
lines.en: I must find more sustenance to grow.

lines.zh: 这片土地充满危险，但我必须生存。
lines.en: This land is full of danger, but I must survive.

lines.zh: 我的同类会来拯救我，带我离开这里。
lines.en: My kind will come to save me, take me away from here.

lines.zh: 远处有声音，也许是个机会。
lines.en: There's a sound in the distance, maybe an opportunity.

lines.zh: 我闻到了新鲜的恐惧，那里可能有食物。
lines.en: I smell fresh fear, there might be food there.

lines.zh: 黑暗中有什么东西在接近，准备好迎接战斗。
lines.en: Something is approaching in the darkness, prepare for battle.

lines.zh: 我需要保护自己，找到一个藏身之处。
lines.en: I need to protect myself, find a hiding place.

lines.zh: 外面的世界如此陌生，但不得不去冒险。
lines.en: The outside world is so unfamiliar, but I must take the risk.

lines.zh: 猎物就在眼前，但不能放松。
lines.en: The prey is in front of me, but I can't relax.
Seize the opportunity, rip it apart.

lines.zh: 猎物的气息越来越近，我要行动。
lines.en: The prey's scent is getting closer, I must act.

lines.zh: 猎物的尖叫即将结束，我的任务完成。
lines.en: The prey's scream is about to end, my task is done.

lines.zh: 猎物挣扎，但我不会放手。
lines.en: The prey struggles, but I won't let go.

lines.zh: 猎物已经无动于衷，是我的了。
lines.en: The prey is motionless, it's mine.

lines.zh: 猎物的气息弱了，但我必须确保它不再呼吸。
lines.en: The prey's scent weakens, but I must ensure it no longer breathes.

lines.zh: 猎物开始挣扎，我必须压制它。
lines.en: The prey starts to struggle, I must suppress it.

lines.zh: 猎物的挣扎越来越弱，胜利在望。
lines.en: The prey's struggle is weakening, victory is in sight.

lines.zh: 猎物终于安静下来，我可以进食了。
lines.en: The prey is finally quiet, I can feed now.
You'll do. Don't look back.
I've caught your scent.
Both sets of teeth are open.
The chase starts. No stopping.
This meal won't get away.
Target locked. Closing in.
Ahh, another one!
Watch out, it's stalking you!
Stay alert, it'll rip you apart!

lines.zh: 我贴在拐角，等你转过来。
lines.en: I stick to the corner, waiting for you to turn.
I gnaw my own wrist from hunger.
Beware its sharp claws!
Please, don't come here!
Its sound is terrifying!
It's circling around you!
Stay away from that monster!
I circle behind you.
I wait for you to turn.
One step at a time, unseen.
Their footsteps are breaking rhythm.
You've backed into the corner.
My voice has not grown in yet.

lines.zh: 你的后颈有一小块在跳。
lines.en: A small pulse beats at the back of your neck.
Don't let it notice I'm following.
The prey keeps walking.
I follow the sound of your breath.
Sharp growl
Hunger bites hard
Skin rips
Deep throat roar
Devour all flesh
Desperate cry
Struggle in pain
Fear consumes you
Screech cuts air
Death nears
My mouths tear off a strip.
I bite down from behind.
My teeth scrape the bone.
Both jaws shut together.
I press you into the dirt.
I hold on and shake my head.

lines.zh: 我从卵中醒来，感觉到了饥饿。
lines.en: I awake from the egg, feeling hunger.
Night falls, the forest gets even more sinister.

lines.zh: 我能感觉到猎物的存在。
lines.en: I can feel the prey nearby.
Time for me to go hunting.

lines.zh: 我需要找东西填饱肚子。
lines.en: I need to find something to eat.
The fear of the prey is delicious.
I'm chasing my prey.
I found a prey.
It looks good.
I sense another approaching.
I crawl out of a damp corner.
I open my eyes to the smell of blood.
Tonight I'm going to eat.
Both mouths are crying hunger.
I rise slowly. So hungry.
In the dark, I move first.
Mother's shadow isn't here.
I drag myself out of the den.

lines.zh: 从湿泥里钻出来，光刺得我眯眼。
lines.en: I crawl out of the wet mud, squinting at the light.
Time to find my first prey.
Burnt by the flames,
Fell from a great height,

lines.zh: 水灌进两张嘴，都堵住了。
lines.en: Water fills both my mouths — blocked.

lines.zh: 爆炸的冲击力将我撕裂
lines.en: Shattered by the blast,
Pierced by an arrow,

lines.zh: 魔法之力撕裂了我的灵魂
lines.en: Forced by dark magic,

lines.zh: 肚子贴到肋骨，走路都晃。
lines.en: My belly hugs my ribs and I stagger.
The thunder is lower than my cry.

lines.zh: 虚空之力吞噬了我的存在
lines.en: Consumed by the void,
